title: Untrusted search path in PostgreSQL vacuumdb allows a database owner to execute arbitrary SQL as the database user…
description: A vulnerability in PostgreSQL vacuumdb prior to version 18.7 within major version 18 allows a database owner to execute arbitrary SQL as the database user running vacuumdb. This is due to an untrusted search path issue involving shadowing operators used in the --missing-stats-only catalog query. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are not affected.
